annotations.title: Edit a Snapchat campaign, ad squad, ad or creative

description: Edit a live or paused Snapchat object IN PLACE, only where Snapchat allows it. campaign / ad: name, startTime, endTime. adsquad: name, startTime, endTime, bid, bidStrategy, pixelId, audiences / excludeAudiences (changing targeting sends its ads back to review and briefly pauses a live squad). creative: name, headline (max 34), brandName (max 32), callToAction, landingPageUrl, utm / addUtm — the URL only on WEB_VIEW creatives; a creative edit re-submits every ad using it for review. Refused BY NAME because Snapchat does not allow them: an ad's creative, a squad's optimization goal or billing event, a creative's type. Status and budget are set_snapchat_ads_status and set_snapchat_ads_budget. confirm:true required — without it NOTHING changes and you get each field's before -> after to show the user. The answer is the READ-BACK, per field.

adAccountId.description: Snapchat ad account id shared with this profile; omit when only one is shared

audiences.description: audience ids the squad TARGETS — replaces its audience targeting; [] clears it

bid.description: ad squad bid in the ad account's currency (converted to micro here)

bidMicro.description: ONLY if already multiplied by 1,000,000; never with bid

bidStrategy.description: AUTO_BID, LOWEST_COST_WITH_MAX_BID or TARGET_COST; ad squads only

brandName.description: new brand name, max 32 characters; creatives only

confirm.description: REQUIRED true — without it nothing changes and you get the before -> after

excludeAudiences.description: audience ids to exclude from the ad squad

headline.description: new headline, max 34 characters; creatives only

id.description: the object id (a creative id comes from the ad row’s creative_id or upload_snapchat_ads_creative)

level.description: object to edit: campaign, adsquad, ad or creative

pixelId.description: Snap Pixel id the ad squad optimises toward; ad squads only

startTime.description: ISO 8601; on an ad squad it must be now or later

utm.description: UTM parameters set on the landing page URL; Snapchat macros like {{campaign.name}} stay literal

campaign.description: utm_campaign on the landing URL; WEB_VIEW creatives only; Snapchat macros stay literal

content.description: utm_content on the landing URL; WEB_VIEW creatives only

medium.description: utm_medium on the landing URL; WEB_VIEW creatives only

source.description: utm_source on the landing URL; WEB_VIEW creatives only

term.description: utm_term on the landing URL; WEB_VIEW creatives only
